# Flair

> Visual effects and motion graphics for the web: WebGL2 shader effects, animated vector effects, a catalog of 450+ ready-made looks, and a UI-agnostic, agent-ready effect editor.

- Website: https://flair.pixerate.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Pixerate/flair
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pixerate/flair
- Full Context: https://flair.pixerate.com/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://flair.pixerate.com/sitemap.xml

## Start Here

- [Introduction](https://flair.pixerate.com/getting-started/introduction/): Overview of the Flair visual effects library and design philosophy.
- [Quick Start](https://flair.pixerate.com/getting-started/quick-start/): Get up and running with Flair in under two minutes.
- [Architecture & Design](https://flair.pixerate.com/getting-started/architecture/): Architectural concepts, entry points, and boundaries.

## Catalog & Gallery

- [Effect Explorer](https://flair.pixerate.com/catalog/explorer/): Search, preview and copy any effect in the Flair catalog.
- [Shader Effects](https://flair.pixerate.com/catalog/shaders/): WebGL2 fragment shaders, categories, and presets.
- [Vector Effects](https://flair.pixerate.com/catalog/vector/): Declarative animated SVG graphics and motion paths.

## Shader Engine

- [Declared Controls](https://flair.pixerate.com/shader-engine/controls/): How @control annotations define interactive parameter surfaces.
- [Interactive Pointer & Trails](https://flair.pixerate.com/shader-engine/interactions/): Built-in uniforms for pointer tracking, click history, and motion trails.
- [Audio & Scroll Reactivity](https://flair.pixerate.com/shader-engine/audio-and-scroll/): How Flair shaders sync with Web Audio streams and page scroll position.

## Vector & Motion

- [SVG Motion](https://flair.pixerate.com/vector-motion/svg-motion/): Deterministic vector frame evaluation and playback.
- [Motion Primitives](https://flair.pixerate.com/vector-motion/motion-primitives/): 23 reusable animation primitives for SVG elements.

## Directing & Scenes

- [Multi-Shot Scenes](https://flair.pixerate.com/directing/scenes/): Directing shots on one board, each arranging catalog effects as layers, with catalog transitions and camera moves between them.
- [Interchange & Exporters](https://flair.pixerate.com/directing/interchange/): Exporting scenes to Lottie, Final Cut Pro XML, and EDL formats.
- [Sequence Templates](https://flair.pixerate.com/directing/templates/): Reusable scenes with typed slots that a person or an agent fills to get a finished scene.

## Editor & Agents

- [Effect Editor](https://flair.pixerate.com/editor-and-agents/effect-editor/): Headless command-based effect authoring and keyframe editing.
- [MCP & Agent Tools](https://flair.pixerate.com/editor-and-agents/mcp-tools/): Declarative tool schemas for autonomous AI coding agents.

## Frameworks

- [React Integration](https://flair.pixerate.com/frameworks/react/): Using Flair in React 18 and 19 applications.
- [Svelte Integration](https://flair.pixerate.com/frameworks/svelte/): Using Flair in Svelte 5 with zero runtime compiler baggage.

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://flair.pixerate.com/reference/api/): Complete public API reference for @pixerate/flair.

## Optional & External Resources

- [Full Documentation Bundle](https://flair.pixerate.com/llms-full.txt): Complete combined documentation in plain text markdown format.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Pixerate/flair): Source code, issues, and discussions.
